params.body: **Carries a migration** (`2026_09_15_160000_add_token_to_vehicle_proposals`: nullable unique `token`, 40 chars, on `vehicle_proposals`). Cutover step 2 is done, so it may merge; Forge runs `migrate --force`. **Behind a flag, off by default**: `config/features.php` → `'relation_proposals' => env('RELATION_PROPOSALS', false)`. Shane's decision of 15 September: "Voorstellen aan relatie" is not active yet, the formula changes later (open point `voorstellen-aan-relatie-nieuwe-formule`). `CUTOVER.md` step 3: `RELATION_PROPOSALS`: leave out or `false`. ## What changed for the user The proposal mail to a relation ("Een wagen voor u … Bekijk de wagen") linked to the Stocklist detail page, which needs a dealer login: the customer landed on a login screen. Now: - **The mail shows the car without a click**: main photo (md, through the app route `stocklist/image/…?md&v=…`; a signed bucket URL is valid for seven days at most and a proposal is read for thirty, so not `urlVoor`'s signed URL and no CID attachment needed), brand and model, year, mileage, fuel, transmission, colour, power, the customer price of the proposal (R S4-2.18), the note, and the proposing dealer's name, phone and e-mail. The button opens the public page. No link into the platform. - **Public page `GET /voorstel/{token}`** (`proposal.public`, no auth, random 40-char token generated when the proposal is created). Customer-mode view (R S5-4.3, R S5-4.9): photos (own vehicle: own photos; colleague's vehicle: the Stocklist set), brand/model/package, year, mileage, fuel, transmission, colour, power, checked options, the proposal's price, the note, and the proposing dealer (name, logo, address, phone, e-mail). Never the trade price, the seller's retail price or the selling garage. Actions: "Bel " (tel:), "Mail " (mailto:) and "Stel uw vraag" (a small lead form posting to `POST /voorstel/{token}/vraag`, through the existing `LeadService`, recipient = the proposing dealer; name/e-mail/phone prefilled from the relation). `noindex`, no navigation into the app, only the footer "Aangeboden via Stocklist Dealer". Paper ground, phone first; the dealer's `website_headcolor` is the accent and `website_font` (Google font) the typeface when the Website settings have them. - **Expiry: 30 days** from `created_at` (`VehicleProposal::VALID_DAYS`, no extra column). After that: "Dit voorstel is niet meer beschikbaar, neem contact op met " with the garage's contact details, HTTP 410. Unknown or malformed token: 404. - **Flag off** (default, also production): the "Voorstellen aan relatie" entry in the own-stock row ⋯ menu and the button in the Stocklist buybox do not render; `GET`/`POST /vehicles/{id}/propose` answer 404. The public page of an already-mailed proposal keeps working: that link is in a customer's mailbox and shows nothing the customer did not already get. Flag on: everything as built. - **Maintenance**: `/voorstel/*` is deliberately not in `PreventRequestsDuringMaintenance::$except`; that list is for machine callers that lose a message on a 503, a customer can retry a minute later. ## Code - `App\Support\ProposalPage`: the one object the mail and the page read from (photos per customer-mode rule, facts, options, price, dealer, accent/font). - `App\Http\Controllers\Vehicle\ProposalPublicController` (`show`, `lead`), views `proposal/_layout`, `proposal/public`, `proposal/expired` (standalone skeleton, inline `ui-proposal-*` styles). - `VehicleProposal`: `token` on `creating`, `publicUrl()`, `expiresAt()`, `isExpired()`, `dealer()`; `VehicleProposalMail` now takes the proposal; `VehicleImageService::duurzameUrlVoor()` (the app-route URL, shared with the local-disk branch of `url()`). - Rule **R S4-2.19** in `docs/bedrijfsregels/14-s4-verkopen-aan-een-klant.md`; open point `docs/bedrijfsregels/open-punten/2026-09-15-voorstellen-aan-relatie-nieuwe-formule.md`. ## Tests `tests/Feature/ProposalPublicPageTest` (7): page renders with customer price, facts, note and dealer contact, without the trade price, the seller's retail price or the seller; expired → friendly page (410), one day before expiry still OK; unknown/malformed token → 404; lead form creates a lead for the proposing dealer and validates; mail HTML contains the photo `` through the app route, the facts, the price, the public URL and no `stocklist.index.detail` link; flag off → entry points gone, routes 404, public page still serves; flag on → entry points render. `VehicleProposalTest` adapted to the table layout of the price and turns the flag on in `setUp`. Screenshots (390 and 1440): `.playwright-mcp/proposal-public-page/voorstel-390.png`, `voorstel-1440.png`. ## Open points - PDF attachment as an alternative to the page: not built (Shane: "either ... or"; the page came first). - The dealer logo on the page goes through `dealer.index.image` (S3 via PHP), like the showroom and the sold/bought mails.
params.title: A proposal opens a public page for the customer, behind a flag that is off
